title: My Tidy Desk
subtitle: 考点：There is / There are / 介词
passage: My desk is tidy now. There is a book, a pencil box and a bottle on my desk. In my pencil box, there are three pens, one eraser and one ruler.
My key is in my schoolbag. I keep my things in the right places. A tidy desk makes me happy!
vocab: tidy 整洁的 · pencil box 铅笔盒 · ruler 尺子 · eraser 橡皮 · key 钥匙

questions.stem: Is the writer's desk tidy now?
How many pens are there in the pencil box?

questions.why: My key is in my schoolbag.

options: A book, a pencil box and a bottle.
questions.why: 桌上是书、铅笔盒和瓶子；笔、橡皮和尺子在铅笔盒里。

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: There are two erasers in the pencil box.
The bottle is on the desk.
The writer's desk is messy now.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: There ____ a bottle on my desk.
questions.why: a bottle 是单数，用 There is。

questions.stem: There ____ three pens in my pencil box.
questions.why: three pens 是复数，用 There are。
